name: triad
description: Tiered-model orchestration: Opus orchestrates, Sonnet codes, Haiku does menial work. The mod enforces the tiers and keeps a token ledger.

maxDepth.title: Max depth below the orchestrator
maxDepth.description: Spawns deeper than this are refused.

maxRetries.title: Max automatic retries per task
maxRetries.description: How many times a non-conforming reply is sent back before it is passed through.

strictMenu.title: Offer only Triad agent types
strictMenu.description: Hide and refuse built-in and other plugins' agent types, which would bypass the tiers.

compress.title: Compress long tool output
compress.description: Save long Bash/Grep output (and log-like files read) to .triad/out and give the agent its error lines plus a Haiku summary.

compressThreshold.title: Compression threshold (tokens)
compressThreshold.description: Output longer than this is compressed.

deferTools.title: Defer rarely used tool descriptions
deferTools.description: Load only the tools the tiers use every turn; the rest stay reachable through ToolSearch.

haikuCeiling.title: Haiku prompt ceiling (tokens)
haikuCeiling.description: A helper whose next request is projected above this is stopped and returns partial. Keep it under 100,000, Haiku's pricing line.

haikuWrapAt.title: Haiku wrap-up threshold (tokens)
haikuWrapAt.description: At this prompt size a helper is told to finish and return.

openPane.title: Open the Triad pane at start
openPane.description: Open the agent tree and spend pane when a session starts (it seats from 144 terminal columns). `/triad pane` opens it at any width.
